input: Any commit that modifies /moves/knight_b8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own key, and any commit that modifies a /moves/<agent>.text path must also modify /turn/ply.num and be co-signed by the queen_d8 key, so that agents who have repeatedly gone off plan cannot push through a lone move.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_b8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/queen_d8.id)] false)
